name: St. Regis Zhuhai
positioning: Waterfront St. Regis in Wanzai, Zhuhai, officially The St. Regis Zhuhai, with restaurants and a spa on high floors
best_for: Travelers who want a waterfront base close to Macau International Airport
Food-focused guests drawn to high-floor Cantonese and Italian fine dining

facts.text: The hotel is a waterfront hotel in Wanzai, Zhuhai.
The closest airport is Macau International Airport, about 14 km from the hotel.
The hotel suggests nearby attractions including Chimelong Ocean Kingdom and The New Yuan Ming Palace.
LaBrezza, on the 71st floor, is an Italian fine-dining restaurant serving Southern Italian cuisine.
Yan Ting, on the 42nd floor, serves classic Cantonese a la carte fine dining with city views of Macao and Zhuhai.
The St. Regis Bar on the 41st floor offers Signature Afternoon Tea and the Pearly Mary.
Rooms have 55-inch Sony TVs and B&O sound systems.

highlights.text: LaBrezza has an open kitchen, a cheese and cold cuts room and a wine cellar with over 400 labels.
Rooms offer in-room setups including 24-hour Butler Service, a Bloody Mary Mixer and a Whiskey Trolley.
Social, the buffet restaurant on the 41st floor, draws inspiration from the first-class dining saloons of early 1900s cruise vessels.
Iridium Spa is on the 68th floor and offers a menu of locally inspired therapies.

considerations.text: The outdoor swimming pool is open from June to October.
The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
